newsitem.title: EGYPT: Sudanese opposition leader Mirghani in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Sudanese opposition leader Mirghani in Cairo.

text.p: Sudanese opposition leader Mohammed Osman al-Mirghani arrived in Cairo from Saudi Arabia on Sunday night at the invitation of the Egyptian government.
Mirghani, who is chairman of the opposition National Democratic Alliance in exile, told reporters at Cairo airport he would stay several days and consult with Egyptian officials.
His visit coincides with one by former Sudanese prime minister Sadeq al-Mahdi, who fled to Eritrea this month after years under surveillance in Khartoum.

Mirghani and Mahdi lead the two big traditional parties in northern Sudan, the Democratic Unionists and the Umma Party. Both parties are in the National Democratic Alliance, along with the southern rebels of the Sudan People's Liberation Movement.
The Sudanese opposition in exile has offices in Cairo but its contacts with the Egyptian government are rarely publicised.
